competitions_type_check.name: competitions_type_check
competitions_type_check.value: (type)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['streaks'::character varying, 'apex'::character varying, 'clash'::character varying, 'targets'::character varying, 'race'::character varying])::text[])

idx_post_comments_post.name: idx_post_comments_post
idx_post_comments_post.where: (deleted_at IS NULL AND post_id IS NOT NULL)

idx_post_comments_workout.name: idx_post_comments_workout
idx_post_comments_workout.where: (deleted_at IS NULL AND workout_id IS NOT NULL)

post_comments_one_target_check.name: post_comments_one_target_check
post_comments_one_target_check.value: ((post_id IS NOT NULL)::int + (workout_id IS NOT NULL)::int) = 1

uq_posts_workout_active.name: uq_posts_workout_active
uq_posts_workout_active.where: (deleted_at IS NULL AND workout_id IS NOT NULL AND share_to_feed)

uq_posts_workout_story.name: uq_posts_workout_story
uq_posts_workout_story.where: (deleted_at IS NULL AND workout_id IS NOT NULL AND share_to_story AND NOT share_to_feed)

posts_coauthor_status_check.name: posts_coauthor_status_check
posts_coauthor_status_check.value: coauthor_status IS NULL OR coauthor_status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'accepted'::text])

idx_workouts_feed_candidates.name: idx_workouts_feed_candidates
idx_workouts_feed_candidates.where: (deleted_at IS NULL AND exclusion_reason IS NULL AND feed_role IN ('daily_mile', 'extra'))
